status: Post-hoc contextual transfer of a fixed descriptive list, not preregistration, untouched validation or a primary replication vote.
scope: Frozen previously fitted effects and LOO caches only; no external refit or new inferential test in this branch.
limitations: Sources and prior effect correlations were seen in earlier exploratory work; not an untouched holdout.
Early P1-P9 tissues cannot be treated as equivalent to later meiotic-arrest tissues.
Two Pramef12 ages and two Lrh1 Cre experiments are not four independent genetic models.
No inference that failure to transfer disproves shared biology, that a sign match proves a mechanism, or that Msl3 supplies a known statistical null.
